kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نبتعد (form VIII)
# نَبْتَعِدُ (nabtaʕidu) /nab.ta.ʕi.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَعَدَ (ibtaʕada)
# نَبْتَعِدَ (nabtaʕida) /nab.ta.ʕi.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِبْتَعَدَ (ibtaʕada)
# نَبْتَعِدْ (nabtaʕid) /nab.ta.ʕid/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِبْتَعَدَ (ibtaʕada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
